title: Marketplace Orders Late-Delivery Compensation
content:
## Policy

On a Northloop-fulfilled delivery option with guaranteed delivery, a Marketplace Orders order delivered after its promised delivery date is owed late-delivery compensation, booked as one late-delivery shipping refund funded by Northloop and sent to the original payment method.

Northloop books the late-delivery compensation itself, without waiting for a request from the buyer, on any handling date no later than the late refund request window counted in calendar days from the delivered date; after that window it is not booked.

On a seller-fulfilled delivery option with guaranteed delivery, an order delivered after its promised delivery date earns a refund of the shipping charge actually paid on the order, funded by the seller, and nothing more; that seller-funded refund is not late-delivery compensation.

### The policy at a glance

| Delivery option | Delivered after the promised date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day or Same-Day (Northloop-fulfilled, guaranteed) | yes | late-delivery compensation, one late-delivery shipping refund, funded by Northloop, to the original payment method |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping or Large Item Freight Delivery (seller-fulfilled, guaranteed) | yes | a refund of the shipping charge actually paid, funded by the seller; not late-delivery compensation |
| any option | no (on or before the promised date) | nothing under this policy |

### Hypothetical timing case

For a hypothetical guaranteed order delivered on 2 June, with a 30-day late refund request window, the compensation may be booked on any handling date up to and including 2 July; from 3 July it is not booked. No request from the buyer is needed. The dates are example inputs.

## Booking tool: `book_late_delivery_compensation_7d003665`

**Capability.** Books a Northloop-funded refund to the buyer on one marketplace order as compensation for a late delivery. One call records one refund entry dated today on that order, sent back to the original payment method, funded by Northloop and carrying no restocking fee, no return shipping fee and no late-return deduction, and lowers the order's net amount paid by the amount booked. The buyer sees the refund on the order's activity immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_late_delivery_compensation_7d003665` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the marketplace order number of the order being compensated, as shown by the order lookup | identifier |
| `return_id` | the return number the refund settles, read from the order activity lookup; pass "" (empty) when the refund settles no return, as is the case for a late-delivery refund | identifier or empty |
| `refund_component` | which component of the order the refund entry covers | exactly one of `item` (pays back the item price of units), `original_shipping` (pays back the shipping charged at checkout), `tax` (pays back sales tax), `late_delivery_shipping` (the compensation owed because a guaranteed delivery arrived later than its promised date) |
| `amount` | the refund amount in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; booked exactly as given |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` the literal "booked" when the refund entry was recorded; `order_event_id` the reference of the new refund entry; `order_id` the order refunded; `refund_component` the component recorded; `amount` the USD amount booked with 2 decimal places; `funded_by` the literal "northloop"; `net_paid_amount` the order's net amount paid including this refund, USD with 2 decimal places; `event_date` the booking date as YYYY-MM-DD.
